services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Have you been dreaming of your perfect vacation spot in the Okanagan? Barefoot Beach Resort offers premium RV sites on an annual rental basis. Our sites are the largest in the Okanagan and our pricing is set with no hidden fees or charges. Your site rental includes cable, Wi-Fi, water and sewer. The only additional charge is a monthly bill for hydro, based strictly on usage. If you don’t use it, you don’t pay! Each site at Barefoot Beach Resort is approximately 2700 sq-ft, with a beautiful lawn and garden for your enjoyment. Barefoot Beach Resort is proud to offer a limited number of premium annual RV rental sites to our guests. Fully serviced 30A or 50A hookups with free Wi-Fi and cable

services.name: Beach City Crossfit
services.desc: Beach City is the first beachfront crossfit gym in North America! We offer crossfit classes of all types including crossfit for teens, women’s only, competitive classes and Olympic lifting. Beach City is also proud to offer our rock-climbing wall during the summer months. Drop-ins are always welcome! Classes and open gym hours are scheduled throughout the day.
